selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What is the name of the first truth in the target passage?
questions.answer: It is the truth of grandeur and sublimity.

questions.question: What example from space is used to show control over vast distances?
questions.answer: The creation and management of stars far apart from each other.

questions.question: In what short time are these living things cared for and brought forth?
questions.answer: In about five or six weeks.

questions.question: What does this spring display give people a sample of?
questions.answer: It gives a sample of a great rising to life again.

questions.question: According to the passage, what does this greatness leave no room for?
questions.answer: It leaves no room at all for any partner.

questions.question: What happens to the idea of shirk in the face of such greatness?
questions.answer: It is completely rejected and uprooted.

questions.question: Why is assigning partners described as a very serious sin?
questions.answer: Because it is an offense against Allah’s glory, greatness, and majesty.

questions.question: How does the Qur’anic warning strengthen the argument?
questions.answer: It shows that associating partners with Allah is treated as the gravest kind of wrong.

questions.question: Why can’t blind causes explain these acts?
questions.answer: Because the acts are wise, measured, life-giving, and firmly ordered.

questions.question: Which truth comes first in the target passage?
questions.answer: The first truth is grandeur and sublimity.

questions.question: What does the passage emphasize about the way this spring work is done?
questions.answer: It is done with precision, balance, and no disorder.

questions.question: Why is spring such an important sign in the passage?
questions.answer: Because huge numbers of living things are brought out in a short time with order and balance.

questions.question: What does the passage mean by saying each of these deeds is really one deed?
questions.answer: It means they all come from the same single source.

questions.question: Why does the passage call all these many works really one act?
questions.answer: Because they come from one single Doer with one will and power.

questions.question: What role does human reason play in this argument?
questions.answer: Right reason recognizes that such partnership is impossible.

questions.question: Why is shirk described as deeply serious in this section?
questions.answer: Because it insults Allah’s grandeur, glory, and exalted rank.

questions.question: What gives these acts their measure and boundaries?
questions.answer: Allah’s wisdom and will give them measure, along with the capacities of created things.

questions.question: How many examples are announced before the passage stops?
questions.answer: Three examples are announced.

questions.question: What is the first truth called in this passage?
questions.answer: It is called the truth of grandeur and sublimity.

questions.question: What example from the sky shows Allah’s power over enormous scale?
questions.answer: The stars, even though they are separated by huge distances.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the result of this spring work?
questions.answer: It describes it as regular, balanced, and free of confusion.

questions.question: What major belief is strengthened by the yearly return of life in spring?
questions.answer: Belief in resurrection is strengthened.

questions.question: What is the logical conclusion after listing these works?
questions.answer: The One doing them must be single, mighty, and unmatched.

questions.question: What effect does Divine grandeur have on the idea of sharing rule?
questions.answer: It completely blocks and removes that idea.
